text: On July 4, 2018, EYCC approved a motion (EY32.60) to install speed humps on Strathburn Boulevard without a review or staff report. The item was adopted with amendments and without debate by City Council on July 23, 2018.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the authorization for traffic calming on Strathburn Boulevard, granted under Part 5 of Item EY32.60, headed "Parking Regulation Amendment - Strathburn Boulevard", adopted as amended, by Etobicoke York Community Council on July 4, 2018.
